title: Split Pea Soup
instructions: Put the consommé, onions, carrots, and beef neck bones (if using) in a large soup pot and bring to a boil.
Add all the remaining ingredients except the potato. Reduce the heat and let the soup simmer for approximately 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Add the potato about 40 minutes before eating. When the potato pieces are done, you're ready to eat! It's as easy as that.
notes: Doc updated quantities: 8 cups water → chicken consommé, 2 cups split peas → 1 cup, 1½ tbsp onion powder → 1 tsp.
